# AI Found Score

> Free report for local businesses showing whether AI assistants (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Microsoft Copilot) name the business when someone in its town asks for its type of service, and whether the business's name, phone, address, and hours match across Google, Apple, Bing, Yelp, and Facebook.

- The free report costs nothing and uses public data only. No logins are required.
- Paid options: Snapshot ($29, step-by-step fix guide), Before & After ($59, we fix listings on all five sites and re-scan), Full Year ($69, adds monthly re-checks for 12 months), Listing cleanup ($199).
- AI Found Score does not guarantee rankings, AI placement, or bookings.
- Company: AI Found Score, 120 Terminal Drive, Plainview, NY 11803. Email: hello@aifoundscore.com
